scope: Additive TH18 Meteor Golem and required Meteormite contract. Current parent values are preserved, while split, throw, merge and child lifecycle remain deliberately unimplemented pending a deterministic public contract.
game_version: The inherited level payload is source commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba. The current parent table is a secondary extraction from client build 18.600.3, published 2026-09-16. Supercell's 2026-07-09 balance note confirms a post-launch Meteor Golem and Meteormite buff but does not disclose the numbers.

sources.title: TOWN HALL 18 Crash Lands! - Update
sources.limitations: Establishes the permanent Home Village Meteor Golem, Town Hall 17 unlock, throwing Meteormites over Walls for close damage, and their remerge. It provides no level values, split trigger, landing geometry, child values, merge range, invulnerability duration, pathing, timing or tie ordering.

sources.title: Cosmic Rock Medal Event!
sources.limitations: The original temporary variant establishes twin Meteormites, closest-target throw, child attack or merge choice, child Wall jumping and parent inability to jump Walls. It does not publish a deterministic range, cadence, child data, split trigger, flight contract or merge schedule. The permanent implementation may differ.

sources.title: July Balance Update
sources.limitations: Confirms a Meteor Golem and Meteormite buff after the January reductions, but intentionally publishes no numeric breakdown.

sources.title: Meteor Golem
sources.version: client build 18.600.3, as reported by publisher
sources.limitations: Provides current L1-L3 parent HP and DPS, housing, ground-and-air target metadata, one-second cadence and five-tile range. It does not provide the parent movement value, thrown-child damage, split trigger, landing, child table, merging or invulnerability.

sources.title: Meteor Golem/Meteormite
sources.limitations: Describes a two-child split, nearest-building targeting, Wall jumping, housing 20, merge health as child-health sum rounded down to 0.5 percent of parent maximum HP and a brief invulnerability. The visible numeric child table predates the official July 2026 buff, so it is preserved only as an uncertainty reference and is not imported as current data.

required_spawned_unit_id.note: The child is deliberately inventory-only until a current, reproducible child table and deterministic split and merge contract are available.

support.note: Core does not replace the documented split-and-merge attack with ordinary splash combat. No actor, projectile or child lifecycle is fabricated.

changed_values.previous_state: Catalogued L1-L3 from the immutable pre-current source commit at 13,000/14,500/16,000 HP and 450/500/550 DPS.
changed_values.replacement: The active reference retains the historical source values and adds current build-18.600.3 parent values of 14,500/16,000/17,500 HP and 480/530/580 DPS.
changed_values.justification: The dated secondary build-pinned table is consistent with Supercell's later official confirmation of a buff. The official post-buff article does not disclose values, so the source tier remains explicit.

changed_values.previous_state: Required permanent child was not recorded in the TH18 scope.
changed_values.replacement: Meteormite is recorded as a mandatory but unmaterializable child of Meteor Golem.
changed_values.justification: Official sources establish throwing and remerging. The available child numeric table is visibly stale after the official July 2026 buff, and sufficient split and merge lifecycle detail is unavailable.

known_uncertainties: No consulted source publishes the attack condition that causes a Meteor Golem to split, whether damage is parent impact, thrown-child impact or both, target acquisition at throw time, throw distance, launch velocity, collision, splash radius, landing placement, child count on low HP, split health partition, or same-tick ordering.
No current build-pinned Meteormite L1-L3 table is available after Supercell's July 2026 buff. The older Fandom child table is intentionally not imported as current data.

No consulted source publishes Meteormite merge search range, priority against nearby targets, target interruption, child timeout, merge condition and clock, health rounding implementation beyond a secondary prose description, invulnerability duration, child level selection, or spell and trap ordering.
Source-verified Meteor Golem and Meteormite footprints, collision dimensions, sprite tier placement, scaling and animation are unavailable. Neither parent nor child is reported visually conformant.
conclusion: Meteor Golem L1-L3 current parent values and the required Meteormite inventory relationship are versioned and hash-pinned. Its unique combat lifecycle remains disabled rather than approximated, so no Core, Headless, Viewer, RL, snapshot or replay behaviour is claimed.
